title: Add minimal DXR Hello pipeline (BLAS/TLAS, PSO, SBT, DispatchRays)
purpose: Establish a working DXR pipeline that renders a gradient via raygen/miss/hit to verify AS/SBT/PSO wiring and PIX instrumentation.

steps.detail: Create src/dxr/{ASBuilder.*, Pipeline.*, SBT.*} utilities with RAII and error logging.
Add shaders/dxr/{raygen.hlsl, miss.hlsl, closesthit.hlsl}; compile with DXC (SM6.3+).
Create DXR state object with subobjects: DXIL lib, hit group, shader/pipeline config, global RS, (optional) local RS and associations.
Build SBT with contiguous raygen/miss/hit sections; record sizes/strides aligned to D3D12_RAYTRACING_SHADER_RECORD_BYTE_ALIGNMENT.
DispatchRays directly to current backbuffer; add PIX events around AS build, SBT build, PSO creation, DispatchRays.

acceptance: Shows a gradient or solid color produced by raygen
PIX capture validates barriers and SBT layout (sizes/strides)
